price_budget.scope: Moderate increase requested after v0.35.0 was judged too cheap. Apply only implemented rows; preserve owned bits, dependencies and XP. Full-route economy remains a player test.

combat_design.request: Make Black play and fight as close as possible to Miguel O'Hara in Across the Spider-Verse; make it fun. Revision 1 review: avoid one-trick pinning, answer bosses, add webbing and air combos, add rows as needed within the 2D mob/boss brawler. Revision 2 review: X for webs approved; remove Collar Toss and Lariat; add one skill that rewards a full combo meter like Red's Momentum/Overclock.

Native upward launch/gravity/collision, chain/hit timing and paid/unpaid R remain. Independent look/feel review on v0.35.1 was 8/10 each; v0.35.2 landing remains player-unconfirmed and was not rechecked in emulator.

Purchased Reel In (bit84/event393, 150 XP, requires Web Yank): airborne Up+A uses one scarlet tether and continuous cast/heave/recovery to bring a foe below/ahead into claw range for chosen Y. Heavy targets zip Miguel. Native velocity/gravity/collision, floor/R/interruption release and unchanged other inputs. Independent review 8.53/10 overall, presentation 8.2 and feel 8.4; player verdict pending.
Ten Black rows cost 75/125/150/150/200/225/125/100/150/150 XP: 1,450 XP now and 2,450 XP for the full planned fourteen rows. Existing owned bits, dependencies and prices retained.

latest_feedback.summary: Implement the next 2099 skill; make it fun/impressive; require independent subagent review of at least 8/10. Reel In ships in v0.36.0 after an independent 8.53/10 weighted score, with presentation 8.2 and feel 8.4. This request and agent review do not imply a new player quality verdict.
